d: We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Electrical Engineer to join our construction team. The ideal candidate must have substantial experience in the UAE construction industry, with strong expertise in electrical systems, site execution, project coordination, and supervision.
We are looking for someone with the technical knowledge and practical experience to independently manage electrical engineering activities and take ownership of project execution.
q: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Extensive experience in electrical engineering within the UAE construction industry is mandatory.
Strong hands-on experience with electrical installation, site supervision, and project execution.
Good knowledge of electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, low-current systems, and related installations.
Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, technical specifications, and BOQs.
Strong understanding of UAE construction regulations, authority requirements, and industry standards.
Proven experience coordinating with consultants, contractors, subcontractors, and project teams.
Strong technical problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office; knowledge of other relevant engineering software is an advantage.
Ability to independently manage responsibilities and handle multiple priorities within a construction project environment.
r: Oversee and manage electrical engineering activities across construction projects.
Supervise electrical installation works, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Review and interpret electrical drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and related documentation.
Coordinate with civil, mechanical, MEP, and other project teams to ensure smooth project execution.
Monitor site progress and ensure electrical works are completed within project timelines.
Conduct site inspections to ensure quality, safety, and compliance with UAE regulations and standards.
Identify and resolve technical issues related to electrical systems and installations.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and relevant authorities.
Review technical submittals, material approvals, and method statements.
Monitor testing, commissioning, and project handover activities.
Ensure all electrical works comply with project specifications, quality standards, and health and safety requirements.
Provide technical guidance and oversee site teams to ensure efficient execution of electrical works.
x: Opportunity to work on construction and development projects.
Professional growth and career development opportunities.
Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

d: The Legal Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and following up on the company's legal matters, managing legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to the agreed working schedule.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field.
Must have completed legal training or be currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm.
Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws.
Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms.
Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

This is a part-time position, with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines.
Timely follow-up on legal cases and deadlines.
Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
Regular updates on pending legal matters.
Effective coordination with lawyers and relevant departments.
Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

Note: The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization.
r: Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company.
Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities.
Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence required for legal proceedings.
Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates.
Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters.
Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements.
Coordinate contract reviews and approvals with the relevant departments.
Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations.
Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents.
Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations.
Assist in ensuring company compliance with applicable legal requirements.
Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence.
Identify potential legal risks and report them to management.
Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities.
Follow up on cases and requests through relevant government platforms, including Najiz.
Prepare official letters and legal correspondence.
Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures.
Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters.
Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations.
Follow up on labor complaints and claims.
Support the preparation of legal documentation related to disciplinary procedures.
Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters.
Maintain accurate and updated legal records.
Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information.
Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines.
Perform other related duties assigned by management.

d: The Senior Legal Counsel – Bridge Holding provides expert legal support across the full private equity investment lifecycle, from deal origination and structuring through execution, portfolio management and exit. Reporting to the Senior Legal Director, the role leads the legal workstreams of acquisitions, minority and majority investments, co-investments and divestments, and advises on the governance and corporate affairs of Bridge Holding, its investment vehicles and portfolio companies. Working closely with the investment team, finance and external counsel, the Senior Legal Counsel protects the firm’s interests, manages legal risk and ensures that every transaction is executed efficiently, on sound terms and in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
q: 6 to 9 years of post-qualification experience in corporate and M&A work, gained in a leading law firm, a private equity firm, a sovereign or family investment office, or an investment holding company.
Qualified lawyer admitted to practise in a recognised common-law or civil-law jurisdiction; a licence or eligibility to practise in Qatar is an advantage.
Proven record of advising on and executing private equity, M&A and investment transactions from term sheet to completion, including cross-border transactions.
Strong drafting and negotiation skills in share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements, subscription and investment agreements, and related transaction documents.
Hands-on experience leading legal due diligence and converting findings into practical contractual protections and deal recommendations.
Sound understanding of investment structuring, holding and special purpose vehicles, minority investor protections, exit mechanisms and transaction financing.
Working knowledge of corporate governance, company secretarial practice and regulatory approvals, including merger control and foreign-ownership requirements.
Familiarity with Qatari commercial and companies law and GCC regulatory frameworks; experience with Qatar Financial Centre structures is an advantage.
Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to investment professionals and support sound investment decisions.
High integrity, discretion and resilience, with the ability to work under tight deadlines and manage several live transactions at the same time.

Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) or equivalent is required; an LLM in corporate, commercial or financial law is preferred. Excellent written and spoken English is essential; Arabic is a strong advantage.
r: Lead the legal execution of private equity transactions, including acquisitions, minority and majority investments, co-investments, bolt-on acquisitions, restructurings and exits.

Draft, review and negotiate key transaction documents, including term sheets, share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements, subscription agreements, investment agreements and disclosure letters.
Coordinate legal due diligence on target companies, review findings with the investment team and translate identified risks into price adjustments, warranties, indemnities and conditions precedent.
Structure investments and holding arrangements, including special purpose vehicles, holding companies and co-investment structures, in coordination with tax, finance and external advisers.

Secure appropriate investor protections in portfolio companies, including board representation, reserved matters, information rights, pre-emption, drag-along, tag-along, exit and anti-dilution provisions.
Manage the closing process for transactions, including conditions precedent, regulatory and merger-control approvals, completion deliverables, funds flow and post-completion obligations.
Prepare the legal sections of investment committee papers and advise the investment team on key legal risks, deal terms and negotiation positions.

Advise on the corporate governance of Bridge Holding, its investment vehicles and portfolio companies, including board and shareholder resolutions, constitutional documents and delegations of authority.
Oversee company secretarial matters across the investment structure, including incorporations, commercial registration filings, statutory registers, powers of attorney and corporate housekeeping.
Monitor portfolio companies’ compliance with shareholder agreements and investment terms, and support them on material corporate transactions, refinancings and governance matters.
Support acquisition and portfolio financing, including facility agreements, security packages, guarantees and lender requirements, in coordination with Finance.
Prepare for and execute exits, including vendor due diligence, sale processes, trade sales, secondary sales and other exit routes.

Advise on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to private equity investing, including foreign ownership, merger control, anti-bribery and corruption, sanctions, anti-money laundering and know-your-customer requirements.
Select, instruct and manage external law firms on transactions and disputes, ensuring quality of advice, value for money and effective control of legal fees.
Manage disputes arising from investments, including warranty and indemnity claims, shareholder disagreements and contractual disputes, in coordination with external counsel.
Maintain transaction precedents, standard templates, legal checklists and a central record of investment documents, obligations and key deadlines across the portfolio.
